items.source:
The place to round to defined by via a field reference that resolves to an integer between -20 and 100,
exclusive.
items.translation: 通过字段引用定义的舍入位置，该引用解析为介于 -20 和 100 之间的整数（不包含边界值）。

items.source: The place to round to defined by an expression that resolves to an integer between -20 and 100, exclusive.

items.source:
ArithmeticOperators.Round rounds a number to a whole integer or to a specified decimal place.
  • If place(int) resolves to a positive integer, $round rounds to the given decimal places.
  • If place(int) resolves to a negative integer, $round rounds to the left of the decimal.
  • If place(int) resolves to a zero, $round rounds using the first digit to the right of the decimal.
items.translation:
ArithmeticOperators.Round 将数字舍入为整数或指定的小数位。
  • 如果 place(int) 解析为正整数，$round 将舍入到给定的小数位数。
  • 如果 place(int) 解析为负整数，$round 将向左（小数点左侧）进行舍入。
  • 如果 place(int) 解析为零，$round 将根据小数点右侧的第一位数字进行舍入。
